profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with over 9 years of expertise in full-stack development, specializing in Ruby on Rails and scalable application
architecture. Demonstrates a strong ability to create custom software solutions and improve user experiences through collaboration
with diverse clients, leveraging skills in Ruby on Rails and React. Committed to advancing innovation and efficiency in software
projects using modern frameworks and agile methodologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Enhance Ruby on Rails for Tether LMS, boosting system functionality and feature scalability.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align development with product vision.
- Implement solutions to improve system efficiency and user engagement.
Utilize Ruby, Rails, Node.js, and React for robust application development.
- Drive performance improvements, achieving measurable results in LMS space.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · SQL · Redis · Heroku · Node.js · PostgreSQL · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with diverse clients to develop and launch customized API, web, and mobile solutions, enhancing client workflows
and user engagement.
- Built and maintained web and mobile applications using React, React Native, Ruby/Rails, PostgreSQL, Heroku, and Git.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed new compliance features for Edvera’s workflow system, supporting efficient data submission and accurate compliance
reporting for clients.
- Utilized Ruby, Rails, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, Minitest, and Git to implement and test new features.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Client: ROA (Remarketing of America); Developed application to track the reposition and remaking of assets. (Technologies: Ruby 2.2.0, Rails 4.2.0, PostgreSQL, Amazon SWF, Minitest, Git)
- Built custom workflow management engine using Amazon SWF.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and optimized health focused application features to improve functionality and ensure a seamless user experience across
platforms.
- Technologies used include Ruby, Rails, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AngularJS, Git, Rspec, Capybara, and Selenium-
Webdriver.

positions.title: Jr. Web Developer - Student
positions.description:
Nashville Software School - Ruby on Rails
- Learned the ins and outs of web application development. Covering the following: HTML, CSS, Javascript, JQuery, Ruby Language, SQL Database Mgmt, Collaborative Development, Ruby on Rails, TDD, APIs and Services, Gems, Source Code Control
